headline: Approved Traffic Division parking changes on Elm and Chestnut Streets and referred PFAS ordinance amendment for technical review
summary: The committee approved a set of parking, meter, and loading zone changes on Elm Street and Chestnut Street near Hanover Street submitted by the Traffic Division. It also voted that an Ordinance Amendment related to PFAS chemicals ought to pass and sent it to the Committee on Bills on Second Reading for technical review.
decisions: Approved the Traffic Division's parking, meter, and loading zone changes on Elm Street and Chestnut Street near Hanover Street.
Voted that the PFAS chemicals Ordinance Amendment ought to pass and referred it to the Committee on Bills on Second Reading for technical review.

decision_evidence.quote: On motion of Alderman Barry, duly seconded by Alderman Goonan, it was voted to approve.

2. Communication from Aldermen Fajardo, Trisciani, and Kaw-uh, requesting 
approval of an Ordinance Amendment related to PFAS chemicals. 
 
Chairman Vincent: If we approve this, it goes to the Committee on Bills on Second 
Reading for technical review.

Ordinance Amendment ought to pass and be referred to the Committee on Bills on

There being no further business, on motion of Alderman Goonan, duly seconded by
